findings.title: Link/contact text from untrusted sources reaches the research surface; A2UI validator accepts it (W1-AC15/AC12)
D7 (quantities quoted verbatim) bypassed by quantity words the detector misses (tenfold, decade, percentage points, couple)
D10 pixel check passes text the user cannot read: white text covered by its own line-through bar reaches the Brain as 'pixel-checked'
URL query/fragment secrets and userinfo are not masked in either layer and reach the Brain (A0-AC7)
Brain slot not yielded to the user's turn; research cancel ignored during synthesis
Verifier keeps citations to sources that do not support the sentence
Assist answer/observation can be emitted after revoke
Dart Assist controller applies stale poll replies (answer shown while paused; a stale reply cancels a new ask)
Expired grant still shown as ACTIVE (prior R1-09 not fixed)
Vision path: page-text secrets not blacked out in the image; capture runs before gate checks; debounce set on refused attempts (vision disabled by default)
Research budget/cancel not checked in the search and feed loops (prior R1-08 not fixed)
NAT64 local-use prefix 64:ff9b:1::/48 judged only by its low 32 bits
IDN hosts can never be fetched (pinned host comparison uses httpx's decoded host)
AssistController used after dispose when an ask reply is in flight
Screenshot capture not bound to the granted target (prior R1-10 not fixed)
D10: covering under one cell of a text node (1-2 characters) passes and can change the meaning
R1-01 repair incomplete: link forms with zero-width space, title-case TLD, IDN host, soft hyphen or U+3002 pass the detector, verify(), the extractive path and the research surface
R1-02 repair incomplete: _in_order is a subsequence test, so a claim cut from one sentence restates a quantity in the Brain's own words, and the quantity-word list still misses common forms
R1-03 not repaired: white text covered by its own line-through bar reaches the Brain as pixel-checked
URL masking still passes some secret-bearing forms: ;jsessionid path parameter, ticket=, hmac=, oauth_verifier=
R2-01 repair still incomplete: title-case or mixed-case real gTLDs missing from the hard-coded _TLDS list pass the link detector, verify(), the extractive path and the research surface
R2-02 repair incomplete: _excerpt lets a claim drop a qualifier next to an undetected quantity word (doubling, halving, quintupled, biweekly), so a changed quantity is shown in the Brain's words
URL redaction ignores path matrix parameters and some token-bearing keys
R3-01 repair still incomplete: punycode (xn--) top-level domains are not links, so they pass has_link_or_contact, verify(), the extractive path and the research surface (W1-AC15/AC12)

R3-02 repair incomplete: _excerpt still lets a claim drop 'a <qualifier>' before an undetected quantity word (decennial, unanimous, quinquennial), so a changed quantity is shown unquoted in the Brain's words (D7)
A Chinese/Japanese host, then U+3002, then an IDN TLD not in _IDN_TLDS is not detected as a link (documented trade-off)

R1-01 class still open: a link next to an underscore or hyphen ('_refunds-portal.com_', 'refunds-portal.com_', '-refunds-portal.com') passes has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator

D7 bypass at the sentence edge: _excerpt lets a claim drop a leading qualifier ('Less than', 'Fewer than', 'Well short of') before an undetected quantity word (plurality, quintet, quorum), so a changed quantity is shown unquoted in the Brain's words
